data.notes: It caught every must-catch item: it cuts the approval-rate claim (A1) despite the win, answers 'what do we lose' on PayPal, Venmo and saved cards, uses 'sitter pay' and 'paid by Friday', and treats the Braintree theory as Priya's guess. Small misses: the trigger leaves out paying sitters locally in new countries and has no line attached (C2/C1), the decider skips the one line for finance on when sitters get paid, and the words finding quotes the CFO instead of Priya's 'paid by Friday' line.
